verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a REST API reference, but nothing in the evidence describes a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation, not an API specification, so it does not count as an equivalent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
